purpose: Permanent metadata-only conclusions from WHITEBLOCK cross-region aerial imagery review. Imagery pixels are not stored in the repository.

method.review_scale: zoom 18 review frames around existing WHITEBLOCK mapped points
method.legal_access_rule: Imagery does not establish legal/public access; source-based access fields remain authoritative.
method.live_occupancy_rule: Imagery does not establish live occupancy or current free-space counts.
method.geometry_rule: No polygon coordinates are created automatically. candidate_polygon_allowed means physical lot presence is clear enough for a separate digitisation/reconciliation task.
